rationale: Preserve Great Western Wind Farm as one historical portfolio-company record, retire the Allianz Global Investors ownership period, and mark the company realized because no current manager-universe owner remains. Allianz's February 2017 release directly supports the historical Allianz Capital Partners and MUFG tax-equity investment. In the official EIA-860 2025 early-release Schedule 4 ownership workbook, Great Western has no jointly or third-party-owned generator row; EIA states that generators absent from that file are wholly owned by their reported operator. Current EDF and Oklahoma Corporation Commission pages continue to associate the operating project with EDF, while no current direct Allianz ownership or publicly disclosed Allianz disposition date was found. The exit year therefore remains null.

supports: Allianz Capital Partners and MUFG invested tax equity in Great Western in February 2017
Allianz described the investment as part of its renewable-energy portfolio at closing
the 2025 early-release data includes Schedule 4 generator ownership records
EIA states that generators absent from the owner file are wholly owned by their operator
the Schedule 4 owner workbook contains no jointly or third-party-owned row for Great Western Wind Energy, LLC or plant 60574
EDF currently maintains Great Western's project page and community contact
the 225 MW project became operational in December 2016 and supplies Google under a long-term PPA
the Oklahoma Corporation Commission lists Great Western Wind Energy, LLC care of EDF Renewable Energy

acquisitionExitCheck.result: The historical Allianz closing source, current EDF project page, Oklahoma Corporation Commission listing, official EIA-860 ownership methodology, and 2025 early-release Schedule 4 ownership workbook were reopened. The current EIA owner file does not report Great Western as jointly or third-party owned, while current project sources continue to associate it with EDF. No current Allianz ownership or public Allianz disposition date was found.
acquisitionExitCheck.ownershipEffect: Retire the Allianz tax-equity ownership period without an inferred exit year and mark the company realized because no current manager-universe owner remains.
